metadata.title: Random But True: The Baboon Who Had a Railway Job
metadata.caption:
James Wide was a railway guard in South Africa who lost both his legs jumping on and off moving trains.

He bought a baboon at a local market, named him Jack, and trained him to help operate the railway signal levers.

Jack got so good at the job that the railway gave him an official employee number and his own wage - after a passenger complained and an inspector tested him personally.

According to the historical record, Jack worked the signals for about nine years and never made a single mistake.
